For the main Llama-3-Instruct (8B) setting, SimPO uses **β = 2.5**, **γ = 1.4** and a **learning rate of 1e-6** (Table 8, p. 18).

The paper also reports an updated **v0.2** setting, which labels preferences with the stronger ArmoRM reward model instead of PairRM (p. 29):

- It uses **β = 10** and **γ = 3** (p. 29).
- The learning rate, batch size and max sequence length are "kept the same as the original Llama-3-8B-Instruct setting," so the learning rate stays at 1e-6 (p. 29).
- This fits footnote 10, which says a large β such as 10 works better for Llama-3-Instruct (p. 9).
- Table 16 marks the released checkpoint as the lr = 1e-6 run, which reaches 53.7 LC on AlpacaEval 2 (p. 31).

**Trade-off with learning rate:** continuing training at a lower rate (4e-7 or 5e-7) gives weaker chat-benchmark scores. However, it preserves GSM8K and MMLU performance better than 1e-6 (Table 16, p. 31).
